$comment: Market leaders probed on 2026-10-31 and the answer each one gave. These are recorded so the outreach list is explicit and nobody probes the same dead end twice. None of these carry a price today. A leader is listed here even when it fails, because knowing that Home Depot returns 404 and Lowe's returns 403 is the finding.
summary: Of 17 market leaders across CN, CA, MX, AU, AE, IT, US and GB, none exposes a fetchable product catalogue. Large merchants either block server-side requests or run platforms with no public product API. Coverage in these markets cannot come from scraping leaders.

leaders.name: Alibaba
leaders.note: returns HTTP 200 to a browser but no catalogue to a server request

leaders.name: Made-in-China
leaders.note: 404 on both catalogue endpoints

leaders.name: Global Sources
leaders.note: same class as the two above; expect the same answer

markets.path_forward: China needs export-facing merchants on Shopify, or a distributor relationship. Public marketplaces will not yield a fetchable price list.
